Q: Which sentence has the correct adjective order:
Options:
(A) big old red car
(B) old big red car

The correct order is: Size (big) -> Age (old) -> Color (red). So, the correct answer is (B) old big red car.

Q: Which sentence has the correct adjective order:
Options:
(A) beautiful small Italian leather handbag
(B) Italian beautiful small leather handbag

The correct order is: Opinion (beautiful) -> Size (small) -> Origin (Italian) -> Material (leather). So, the correct answer is (A) beautiful small Italian leather handbag.

Q: Which sentence has the correct adjective order:
Options:
(A) long wooden old bridge
(B) old long wooden bridge

The correct order is: Age (old) -> Size (long) -> Material (wooden). So, the correct answer is (B) old long wooden bridge.

Q: Which sentence has the correct adjective order:
Options:
(A) expensive electronic Japanese smartwatch
(B) Japanese expensive electronic smartwatch

The correct order is: Opinion (expensive) -> Origin (Japanese) -> Purpose (electronic) -> Purpose (smartwatch). So, the correct answer is (A) expensive electronic Japanese smartwatch.
